card.title: How to fix iPhone 16 pro or pro max boot looping on Apple logo

source.title: How to fix iPhone 16 pro or pro max boot looping on Apple logo

claims.statement: An iPhone 16 Pro bootlooping despite a new battery and reflash had Analog_BATT_VCELL_POS_CONN open (OL) at the battery connector; its only other connection is U4200 (USB/charging IC), and replacing U4200 fixed it.

procedure: Try a known-good battery and a DFU flash.
Diode-check Analog_BATT_VCELL_POS_CONN at the battery connector.
Trace through the layers; if OL to U4200, replace U4200.
Re-measure and test boot and charging.
card.caveats: Single case write-up. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
